notes: Hashes are exact bytes; all 148 raw files are preserved byte-identically, with candidates.json renamed to trajectory.json.
Full requests, responses and summaries were reviewed and contain no private absolute paths or credential material; no source content redaction was needed.
run-outcomes, request-index, candidate-source-manifest and pair-input-verification are derived independent audit views; README explains their scope.
Final audits include the preregistered parent value and later child outcome; no separate immutable pre-execution audit file existed and none was fabricated.
The manifest excludes itself from archive_files to avoid self-referential hashing.
Eight copied baseline files represent two existing development states and were not executed again.
SDK MaxIterationsReached is the configured one-iteration bound; all eight sessions actually executed one candidate.
